facts.fact: The tax on new SIM-card digital terminals (RTN), in force since 1 June 2026, was reported by ADEN's director general to the National Assembly's finance committee on 16 July 2026 as operating, with collection mechanism and first results presented; proceeds are to fund connectivity, digital services and digital transformation, within the national strategy for financing digital transformation. No law is named and no yield is given.
facts.system: Taxe sur les nouveaux terminaux numériques à cartes SIM (RTN)
